description: A collaborative team driven by curiosity, critical thinking, and innovation.
summary: Our project explores two places on Earth that are similar to Mars: the Atacama Desert in Chile and the McMurdo Dry Valleys in Antarctica. We compare their environments with Mars, focusing on dryness, cold temperatures, and rocky land. Our presentation shows how studying these places can help scientists prepare for future Mars missions.
details: Our project compares two extreme places on Earth, the Atacama Desert in Chile and the McMurdo Dry Valleys in Antarctica, with Mars. It shows how their dry, cold, and rocky environments are similar to Mars. We created a visual presentation using research, images, and Canva. We did not use coding or special hardware. Our project helps people understand how scientists study Earth to prepare for future Mars missions. We explained temperature, dryness, soil, rocks, and terrain. Our project is creative because it connects real places on Earth to the environment of another planet.
